question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between A and D. Only two people sit to the left of A. G is not an immediate neighbour of D. G sits second to the right of E. F sits to the immediate right of C. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) Only two people sit to the left of A.

2) Only three people sit between A and D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abde9c373d79efa61b9f5bbf9251d51b20e4e13d21d481a275b6161cd99ff4a3.png]
